retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast male portrait against a black void featuring iconic 80s spiky blonde hair and top-right aligned asymmetric typography.
triggerTerms: dark studio portrait with top-right text
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
modern minimalist flat design is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key studio portrait of a man with voluminous, spiky blonde hair. The subject is positioned on the left, emerging from a deep black background. Typography is clustered in the upper right corner, creating a diagonal tension with the subject's face.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left third balanced by negative space on the right
High-key blonde hair texture against low-key black background
Clean serif display type paired with expressive handwritten script
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool black shadows
coreInvariants: Spiky, textured blonde hair as the primary visual focus
Top-right alignment for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject occupies the left 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright texture of the spiky hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright hair on the left, moves down to the face, then travels across the dark space to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space occupies the center and right-middle of the composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between hair and background; low saturation except for skin and red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a thin, rapid-stroke handwriting style
Mixed case for primary name with specific capitalization logic
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' in primary text features a red dot or diamond
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal serif paired with informal, energetic script for a 'signed' look.
graphicDevices: Small red geometric dot above the lowercase 'i'

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of the primary name.
Captures the 80s handwritten aesthetic of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with 1980s spiky blonde hair and a dark jacket, positioned on the left side of a solid black background with dramatic studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a white high-contrast serif font in the top right corner, and a subtitle in red handwritten script immediately below it.

verificationChecks: Is the text aligned to the top right?
Is the hair spiky and blonde?
Is the subtitle red and script-based?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Limahl'
Do not use the specific title 'Don't Suppose'
Avoid exact replication of the subject's facial features
postGenerationChecks: Check that the subject is off-center to the left
Ensure the hair is the brightest part of the image
Confirm the presence of both serif and script fonts
